pages.text: “Spores drift in the air, light and weightless—a gentle breeze might just lift the traveler’s steps.”$(br2)Spore Blossom Tea is a mystical beverage made from dried spore blossoms and sugar. The tea carries a faint forest aroma. Drinking it may grant travelers a brief sensation of floating, offering a unique experience.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Spore Blossom Tea, $(br)blend dried spore blossoms with sugar.$(br)It is an intriguing drink to try during travels, but be aware—it may cause temporary levitation, leading to unexpected outcomes.

Upon drinking Spore Blossom Tea, travelers may experience a mysterious effect, with a small chance of gaining a temporary Levitation state.$(br)This tea is full of surprises, perfect for adventurers seeking new and unexpected experiences.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
